principle: The thesis is an academic research manuscript, not a description of how the manuscript was produced. Internal production commentary stays outside it, while scientific accuracy and required institutional disclosures remain intact.
enterprise_equivalent: A professional document communicates its intended business, technical or legal subject in the issuing party's appropriate voice, not the process used to produce it.
rules: Write in the intended author's or issuing organization's appropriate professional voice. First person requires truthful attribution and institutional permission; third person is legitimate for outside authors and participants.
Present evidence, methods, findings, citations, business terms and conclusions appropriate to the document. Never invent research, results, signatures, credentials or approvals.

Keep editorial instructions, AI/chat narration, source-control identifiers, version labels, build logs, correction registers and internal QA/status commentary out of recipient-facing content. Preserve legitimate technical terms, research methods, substantive provenance, necessary legal/draft markings and required assistance disclosures.

Review source and rendered output, including figures, captions, tables, covers, appendices, slide content and recipient-facing speaker notes. Resolve contextual findings before release; do not erase real limitations or disclosures to pass a word filter.

Before each new version read current shared policy and owning controls. Preserve stable live IDs, canonical source paths and applicable PRE/POST history. Keep internal review in the existing owner Google Doc. Regenerate from source, verify delivery, and preserve archived versions.

Applies to LaTeX, PDF, Google Docs, DOCX, PPTX, circulating spreadsheets and document-derived web pages. Internal governance pages and explicit review records are separate. Existing factual and human approval gates remain independent.

patterns.regex: \b(?:internal QA checklist|prompt ledger|source-control commit SHA|PRE/POST audit snapshot|AI-generated draft for review)\b
